lines: Seat 1 chooses Wanderer: at the end, 1 point per separate group of tiles beyond the first, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Hexer: at the end, 1 point per Scorch or Blight cast, up to 3.
Bid 4 mana on the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 4 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 wins the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 3) for 4 mana.
Seat 1 gets the Wild tile at (-1, -1) (yields 1) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Wild tile at (0, -1) (yields 1) for free.
Pass: you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2).

Seat 3 wins the Steady tile at (1, 1) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Seat 2 wins the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Seat 1 gets the Shifting tile at (-1, 0) (yields 3) for free.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Seat 1's trait is Wanderer.
Seat 2's trait is Hexer.
Seat 3's trait is Hearthkeeper.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 5 mana.
Seat 3 collects 5 mana.
Attune the Shifting tile at (1, -1) (yields 3) for 4 mana, leaving 3. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
Summon 3 Golems at (-1, 0) for 6 mana, leaving 6.
Round 1.
Seat 2 and Seat 3 both attune the Shifting tile at (1, -1) (yields 3): nobody gets it.
Seat 1 summons 3 Golems at (-1, 0).
Seat 3 casts Blight on the Shifting tile at (-1, 0) (yields 3): it yields nothing next round.

Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
